numerals.meaning: Table 5-1 (matches the page heading 'APPENDIX A — TABLE 5-1 (ARABIC)' in the text layer)

blocks.translation: The maximum permitted height in each zone of the site is set as follows:

lines.source: يُحدِّد الحدّ الأقصى المسموح به للارتفاع في كل منطقة من مناطق الموقع على النحو الآتي:

blocks.translation: Column headings, right to left: Zone | Description | Maximum height (metres above natural ground level) | Warning lighting

lines.source: الحدّ الأقصى للارتفاع (متر فوق منسوب الأرض الطبيعية) | الإنارة التحذيرية

uncertain: no ruled grid was detected although the image shows a ruled table; columns are separated here with ' | ' in reading (right-to-left) order, which is a reading convention, not printed text

blocks.translation: Zone A | The part of the site lying within a distance of 1,500 m of the eastern boundary of the site | 25 | Required

lines.source: أ | الجزء من الموقع الواقع ضمن مسافة ١٬٥٠٠ متر من الحدّ الشرقي للموقع | ٢٥

numerals.meaning: maximum height 25 m above natural ground level, zone A
distance 1,500 m from the eastern site boundary

uncertain: the thousands separator in ١٬٥٠٠ is read as the Arabic thousands separator (U+066C); it could be printed as an apostrophe-like mark; reviewer to confirm it is not a decimal mark (1.5)

blocks.translation: Zone B | Remainder of the site area | 40 | Required for any part whose height exceeds 30 metres

lines.source: ٤٠ | مطلوبة لأي جزء يزيد ارتفاعه على ٣٠ متراً

numerals.meaning: 30 metres: height above which warning lighting is required in zone B
maximum height 40 m above natural ground level, zone B

blocks.translation: Notes:
1. These limits apply to all permanent and temporary structures, including stacks, cranes and construction equipment.

lines.source: ١. تسري هذه الحدود على جميع المنشآت الدائمة والمؤقتة، بما في ذلك المداخن والرافعات ومعدّات الإنشاء.

blocks.translation: 2. Height is measured from natural ground level before grading and filling works.

lines.source: ٢. يُقاس الارتفاع من منسوب الأرض الطبيعية قبل أعمال التسوية والردم.

blocks.translation: 3. The Office must be notified at least thirty (30) days before any crane is erected on the site.

lines.source: ٣. يجب إخطار المكتب قبل ثلاثين (٣٠) يوماً على الأقل من تركيب أي رافعة في الموقع.

uncertain: 'days' is not qualified as calendar or working days in the image; how it maps to the pack's day conventions is for a person to decide
